sources.publisher: iHeart / The XRP Podcast with Paul Barron
sources.title: Crypto Panics! with Dr. Kamilah Stevenson
claims: The host introduces the guest as Camilla; the guest speaks as Camila and says she is on X as 'cam i am cam Stevenson', Instagram as Kamilla Stevenson, and YouTube as 'doctor Camilla Stevenson'.
The guest warns that fake pages exist and asks viewers to use her named handles.
limitations: The transcript is automatically generated and has spelling variations. It does not explicitly state that @drkamilahstevenson is the exact YouTube handle, so the channel mapping remains probable rather than fully first-party verified.

sources.title: Ripple Just Became a BANK — And XRP Holders Need to Understand This
claims: The page attributes the video to Kamilah Stevenson, dates it 2025-12-14, and links original YouTube video ID QslbjGQD0MU.
The transcript speaker introduces herself as 'Camila Stevenson'.
The transcript says Ripple was 'becoming a bank', says a banking license changes its relationship with banks, and claims direct access to banking rails/no intermediaries.

The speaker frames XRP as a liquidity instrument involving collateral, yield and lending; predicts that stress in Japan's reverse carry trade could make XRP a logical pick; and asserts dark pools, OTC and ETFs could create a supply shock.
limitations: Transcript is an automated/third-party rendering and may contain transcription errors.
Claims in the transcript are creator opinion unless independently supported; title and framing must be checked against the legal status at publication.

sources.publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
sources.title: OCC decision letter — Application to Charter Ripple National Trust Bank
claims: OCC granted preliminary conditional approval only on 2025-12-12.
The proposed bank would conduct operations of a trust company and related activities, including fiduciary activities.
The letter states final approval and authorization to commence business would not be granted until all pre-opening requirements were met.
limitations: The letter describes the approval state on 2025-12-12; the later effective date is recorded separately in OCC CAS.

sources.publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
sources.title: Corporate Applications Search — Ripple National Trust Bank
claims: OCC CAS records receipt 2025-07-02, approval 2025-12-12 and consummated/effective 2026-10-26 for Ripple National Trust Bank.
The filing type is a national trust bank under a holding company and trust powers were requested.
limitations: Consummated/effective charter status is not by itself proof of a specific payment-rail connection, Fed master account, deposit-taking authority or volume of XRP activity.

sources.title: Ripple Secures Federal Approval to Establish National Trust Bank
claims: Ripple's own release called the OCC approval conditional and said final approvals were still required.
The release describes the planned bank as a trust bank, with RLUSD reserve-management oversight as a core purpose.
limitations: Company statement; it does not establish that the trust bank was already operating on the publication date.
